name: mcp-dotnet
description: Microsoft Teams and Azure DevOps MCP servers (.NET) with companion skills for messaging, watching conversations, handling a message end to end, and re-authenticating, plus a send gate and drafts pane for Teams drafts.

sendGate.title: Teams send gate
sendGate.description: Refuse Teams sends to anyone but the self chat unless the body was approved by a reaction on its self-chat draft or a Send press in the drafts pane.
